title: Voxel Universe
description: Build and explore a shared, moddable block universe.
firstProject: Create a village with one building for each invention.
availability: Luanti is installable; Mineclonia and WonderForge mod need setup.

title: Pixel & Paint
description: Paint worlds, design textures, and animate original characters.
firstProject: Draw a robot with three distinct facial expressions.
availability: Krita/GIMP via apt; Scratch supported on Raspberry Pi OS Full.

title: 3D Object Forge
description: Model, sculpt, and animate blocky game assets.
firstProject: Build a low-poly spaceship with six unique parts.
availability: Blockbench is a browser PWA; offline install needs an initial online setup.

title: Code Engine
description: Turn ideas into working games and machines.
firstProject: Make an object move when a key is pressed.
availability: Scratch and Thonny supported; Godot install/renderer must be tested on actual hardware.

title: Electronics Hangar
description: Make LEDs, sensors, motors and microcontrollers useful.
firstProject: Write code that blinks an LED with a pattern.
availability: Use a Pico 2 W and 3.3V circuits; adult-supervised electronics only.

title: Sound Reactor
description: Compose, code, and record music for your own creations.
firstProject: Produce a 20-second original theme for an explorer.
availability: Sonic Pi has an ARM64 AppImage option; audio integration needs Pi testing.

title: Science Observatory
description: Explore the real sky, data, and scientific models.
firstProject: Create a chart of the Moon’s phases.
availability: Core Python works locally; certain datasets require separate downloads.

title: Learning Vault
description: An offline library of experiments, lessons, and references.
firstProject: Research a question and record a credible source.
availability: Software is free; content is not bundled and requires license-reviewed downloads.

title: Technical Design Lab
description: Draw engineering plans, circuit boards, and 3D-printable forms.
firstProject: Design a keychain with a measured hole and thickness.
availability: Heavy CAD apps are optional; performance varies across Pi models.
